name: Prehistoric Caves of Yagul and Mitla in the Central Valley of Oaxaca
description: In Oaxaca's Tlacolula valley, this site combines caves and rock shelters with the pre-Hispanic ruins of Yagul and Mitla. In Guilá Naquitz cave, squash seeds about 10,000 years old and early corn cob fragments mark some of the earliest known crop domestication in the Americas. They show how wandering foragers became farmers, laying the groundwork for Mesoamerica's great civilizations.
